tools.name: check-password-pwned
tools.description: Check if a password has been exposed in a known data breach using the k-anonymity Pwned Passwords API. The password is hashed with SHA-1 in the browser; only the first 5 characters of the hash are sent to the API. Returns whether the password was found and how many times.

password.description: The password to check for exposure in known data breaches

tools.name: navigate-to-section
tools.description: Navigate to a section of the Have I Been Pwned website.

section.description: The section to navigate to: 'home' (email breach search), 'passwords' (Pwned Passwords check), 'notify-me' (breach notifications), 'api' (API documentation), 'breaches' (full breach catalogue), 'subscription' (pricing plans), 'donate', 'about', 'faq'

tools.name: search-breaches-for-email
tools.description: Search Have I Been Pwned for data breaches linked to an email address. If the breach search form is present on the current page it is pre-filled and the search is initiated; otherwise navigates to the home page with the email ready to search.

email.description: The email address to search for in known data breaches

tools.name: view-breach-details
tools.description: Navigate to the detail page for a specific data breach to learn what data was compromised, how many addresses were affected, and what happened.

name.description: The breach name identifier as listed on HIBP (e.g. 'Adobe', 'LinkedIn', 'Collection1')
